xp_economy.stacking: All earlier milestone achievements remain unlocked.
xp_economy.streak: Any positive-duration study entry makes a calendar day count.

implementation_rules: Read current user-configured targets for syllabus, PYQs, tests, mocks and revision.
Do not hardcode PYQ/test/mock/revision total targets into achievement logic.
Use the live Overall GATE Readiness calculation for The Endgame.
Evaluate achievements after relevant state changes and on data import/reset.
Persist unlocked IDs and cumulative XP.
Achievement thresholds stack; later milestones do not replace earlier ones.
